63201.meaning1: attainment of virtue; moral success; being accomplished in ethical conduct
63201.commentary: (DNa) sīlasampadā'ti, tattha katamā sīlasampadā? kāyiko avītikkamo'ti evaṃ pubbe vuttasoraccam'eva sīlassa sampādanato paripūraṇato sīlasampadā'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca sīlasampanno sīlasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

appamatto samāno sīlasampadaṃ ārādheti. so tāya sīlasampadāya attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo. so tāya sīlasampadāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti, aham'asmi sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū dussīlā pāpadhammā'ti.

63202.meaning1: talk on the attainment of virtue; discussion about moral success

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca sīlasampanno sīlasampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

63203.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on the attainment of virtue
63203.sanskrit: śīla + saṃpadā + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

63208.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on the attainment of virtue
63208.sanskrit: śīla + saṃpadā + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

63209.meaning1: for the benefit of the attainment of virtue; for the advantage of being accomplished in ethical conduct

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ, na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ. yā ca kho ayaṃ, bhikkhave, akuppā cetovimutti, etadattham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan'ti.

63210.meaning1: because of the successful attainment of virtue; due to moral excellence

examples.text: n'āvuso, sattā ñātisampadāhetu vā bhogasampadāhetu vā ārogyasampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. sīlasampadāhetu vā, āvuso, sattā diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

63211.meaning1: of excellent morality; accomplished in virtue

examples.text: sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.

63212.meaning1: more skilled in morality; more accomplished in virtue (than)
63212.commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya attanā sīlasampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.

63214.meaning1: moral restraint; ethical conduct and self-control

examples.text: kuto pan'assa, bhante, dussīlassa pāpadhammassa evarūpo sīlasaṃyamo bhavissatī'ti?

63215.commentary: (DNa) na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato'ti yāni asaṃvaramūlakāni bhayāni uppajjanti, tesu yaṃ idaṃ bhayaṃ sīlasaṃvarato bhaveyya, taṃ kutoci ekasaṃvarato'pi na samanupassati. kasmā? saṃvarato asaṃvaramūlakassa bhayassa abhāvā.

examples.text: sa kho so, mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati, yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.

63216.meaning1: restrained by ethics; moderated by morality

examples.text: etam'atthavasaṃ ñatvā, paṇḍito sīlasaṃvuto, nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, khippam'eva visodhaye.

63217.meaning1: with virtue in common; with ethical conduct in harmony (with)
63217.commentary: (MNa) sīlasāmaññagato viharatī'ti tesu tesu disābhāgesu viharantehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ samānabhāv'ūpagatasīlo viharati.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi c'eva raho ca.
katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.

63225.meaning1: precepts and practices; ethics and observances; rites and rituals
63225.commentary: (SNPa) sīlavatānī'ti pātimokkh'ādīni sīlāni āraññik'ādīni dhutaṅgavatāni ca. (NIDD1) yo tattha saṃyamo saṃvaro avītikkamo, idaṃ sīlaṃ. yaṃ samādānaṃ taṃ vataṃ. saṃvar'aṭṭhena sīlaṃ, samādān'aṭṭhena vataṃ.

examples.text: yo attano sīlavatāni jantu, anānupuṭṭho'va paresa pāva, anariyadhammaṃ kusalā tam'āhu, yo ātumānaṃ sayam'eva pāva.
etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavataṃ nu jīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.

63226.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of sīlavant

examples.text: soḷas'ākārasampannā, aṭṭh'aṅgasusamāgatā, tādisī sīlavatī upāsikā, upapajjati devalokaṃ manāpan'ti.
itthī'pi hi ekacciyā, seyyā posa janādhipa, medhāvinī sīlavatī, sassudevā patibbatā.

63227.meaning1: having precepts and practices; endowed with ethics and observances
63227.commentary: (ITIa) pātimokkhasaṃvar'ādi-sīlena c'eva āraññik'aṅg'ādi-dhut'aṅgavatehi ca upapanno sampanno samannāgato'ti sīlavat'ūpapanno. (SNPa) catupārisuddhisīlena dhut'aṅgavatena ca upapannattā sīlavat'ūpapannaṃ (THa) sīlavat'ūpapanno'ti ukkaṃsagatena catupārisuddhisīlena, dhutadhammasaṅkhātehi vatehi ca upapanno samannāgato.

examples.text: hito bahunnaṃ paṭipajja bhoge, taṃ devatā rakkhati dhammaguttaṃ, bahussutaṃ sīlavat'ūpapannaṃ, dhamme ṭhitaṃ na vijahati kitti.
satthā hi loke paṭhamo mahesi, tassanvayo sāvako bhāvit'atto, ath'āparo pāṭipado'pi sekho, bahussuto sīlavat'ūpapanno.

63228.meaning1: observance of morality; good conduct; ritual behaviour

examples.text: yaṃ tvaṃ apāyesi bahū manusse, pipāsite ghammani samparete, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

63230.commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) sīlavantan'ti pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirataṃ, adinn'ādānā paṭivirataṃ, musāvādā paṭivirataṃ.

examples.text: diṭṭhiñ'ca anupaggamma, sīlavā dassanena sampanno, kāmesu vineyya gedhaṃ, na hi jātu gabbhaseyya punaretī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.

63231.meaning1: benefit of principled behaviour; advantage of ethical conduct

63236.meaning1: who professes a doctrine of ethical conduct; who teaches ethics
63236.meaning2: who profess a doctrine of ethical conduct; who teaches ethics

examples.text: santi, kassapa, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīlavādā. te anekapariyāyena sīlassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.

63237.meaning1: failure in morality; going wrong ethically

examples.text: idha, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamād'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati. ayaṃ paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhivipatti. sīlavipattihetu… cittavipattihetu… diṭṭhivipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

63239.meaning1: who has transgressed the moral precepts; who has broken the moral code (regarding)
63239.meaning2: who has trespassed the moral precepts
63239.commentary: (VINa) adhisīle sīlavipanno'ti-ādīsu pārājikañ'ca saṅgh'ādisesañ'ca āpanno adhisīle sīlavipanno nāma. (DNa) sīlavipanno'ti vipannasīlo bhinnasaṃvaro.

examples.text: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti, appassuto hoti, duppañño hoti

63240.meaning1: for the sake of purity of ethical conduct; for the purpose of purification of moral behaviour

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, sīlavisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

63241.meaning1: purity of ethical conduct; purification of moral behaviour

examples.text: sīlavisuddhiṃ kho ahaṃ, sāḷha, aññataraṃ sāmaññ'aṅgan'ti vadāmi. ye te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā tapojigucchāvādā tapojigucchāsārā tapojigucchāallīnā viharanti, abhabbā te oghassa nittharaṇāya.
kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, sīlavisuddhi anupādāparinibbānan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.

63242.meaning1: by means of purity of ethical conduct; based on purification of moral behaviour

examples.text: santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā dvayena oghassa nittharaṇaṃ paññapenti, sīlavisuddhihetu ca tapojigucchāhetu ca. idha, bhante, bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

63248.meaning1: growth in ethical conduct; increase in virtue

examples.text: katamā tisso? saddhāvuddhi, sīlavuddhi, paññāvuddhi, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vuddhiyo'ti.

63249.meaning1: relying on ethical conduct; supported by morality
63249.commentary: (ANa) sesapadesu pan'ettha ayam'adhippāyo, brāhmaṇā tāva mante labhitvā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti, gahapatikā yaṃkiñci sippaṃ, itthī kuladāyajjasāmikaṃ puttaṃ, corā yaṃkiñci āvudhasatthaṃ, samaṇā sīlaparipuṇṇā laddhapatiṭṭhā nāma honti. tasmā mant'ādhiṭṭhānā'tiādīni vuttāni.

63250.meaning1: ruled by ethical conduct; governed by morality

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.

63252.meaning1: supported by virtue; assisted by good conduct

examples.text: idh'āvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīl'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sut'ānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacch'ānuggahitā ca hoti, samath'ānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassan'ānuggahitā ca hoti.

63253.meaning1: recollection of one's virtue; remembering one's conduct

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

63254.meaning1: reliance on ethical conduct; dependence on morality

63256.meaning1: in the habit of; accustomed to; of such nature

examples.text: abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vuḍḍh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.
niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

63257.meaning1: who takes conduct as the highest ideal
63257.commentary: (SNPa) sīlaṃ'y'eva uttaman'ti maññamānā sīl'uttamā (NIDD1) sīl'uttamā … sant'eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sīl'uttamavādā

examples.text: sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhav'ūpanītā kusalā vadānā.

63258.meaning1: chanting of ethical conduct; recitation of precepts

63259.commentary: (ANa) sīl'uposathan'ti attano sīl'ānussaraṇavasena upavuttho uposatho sīl'uposatho nāma.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako sīl'uposathaṃ upavasati, sīlena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, sīlañ'c'assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. evaṃ kho, visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.

63260.meaning1: in virtuous conduct one should be

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti… sīsena'pi kammaṃ karoti, kaṇṇehi'pi kammaṃ karoti

ayo, lohaṃ, tipu, sīsaṃ, sajjhaṃ, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya

63263.meaning1: (of a battle) front; forefront; front line

examples.text: phuṭṭho ḍaṃsehi makasehi, araññasmiṃ brahāvane, nāgo saṅgāmasīs'eva, sato tatr'ādhivāsaye.
sotāpanno'ham'asmī'ti idaṃ desanāsīsam'eva. sakadāgāmi-ādayo'pi pana sakadāgāmīham'asmī'ti-ādinā nayena byākaronti yevā'ti.

63267.meaning1: with a head; having a (certain kind of) head; -headed

examples.text: uṇhīsasīso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena dant'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ

63270.meaning1: knocking the head; bumping the head
63270.commentary: (VINa) sīsaghaṭṭāyā'ti y'āyaṃ sīsaghaṭṭā hoti, tatthā'pi anāpatti. na hi sakkā tattha heṭṭhāpāsāde anoṇatena vicarituṃ, tasmā asañcaraṇaṭṭhānattā parapīḷā na bhavissati. (VVt) sīsaghaṭṭāya vā'ti sīsaghaṭṭanappamāṇatalāya kuṭiyā vā.

examples.text: anāpatti, avehāsakuṭiyā sīsaghaṭṭāya heṭṭhā aparibhogaṃ hoti, padarasañcitaṃ hoti, paṭāṇi dinnā hoti, tasmiṃ ṭhito gaṇhati vā laggeti vā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena saṃphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.
atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.
pārājiko hotī'ti seyyathā'pi nāma puriso sīsacchinno abhabbo tena sarīrabandhanena jīvituṃ, evam'eva bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo. tena vuccati, pārājiko hotī'ti.

63274.meaning1: worthy of capital punishment; deserving decapitation
63274.meaning2: resulting in decapitation; chopping off the head

examples.text: tatr'aññatarassa thalaṭṭhassa purisassa evam'assa, pāpakaṃ vata, bho, ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ akāsi gārayhaṃ sīsacchejjaṃ.

63277.meaning1: who has washed their head; who has bathed their head

examples.text: iṅgha tvaṃ, tāta, ariye cakkavattivatte vattāhi. ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ te ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsanhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pātubhavissati sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūran'ti.

63278.meaning2: changing form one's head to another's in carrying a burden

63279.meaning1: Simsapa tree; Dalbergia tree; Indian Rosewood

examples.text: appamattakāni, bhante, bhagavatā parittāni sīsapāpaṇṇāni pāṇinā gahitāni, atha kho etān'eva bahutarāni yadidaṃ upari sīsapāvane'ti.
appamattakāni, bhante, bhagavatā parittāni sīsapāpaṇṇāni pāṇinā gahitāni, atha kho etān'eva bahutarāni yadidaṃ upari sīsapāvane'ti.

63281.meaning1: grove of Simsapa trees; Dalbergia tree forest

examples.text: appamattakāni, bhante, bhagavatā parittāni sīsapāpaṇṇāni pāṇinā gahitāni, atha kho etān'eva bahutarāni yadidaṃ upari sīsapāvane'ti.

63283.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Saccasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
63283.meaningLit: section on the grove of Simsapa trees

63285.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sīsappacālaka
63285.meaning1: swinging the head; swaying the head; wobbling the head

examples.text: na sīsappacālakaṃ antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na sīsappacālakaṃ antaraghare gantabbaṃ. sīsaṃ paggahetvā gantabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sīsappacālakaṃ antaraghare gacchati sīsaṃ olambento, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

63287.commentary: (VINa) so sīsabhār'ādi-vasena catudhā dassito. tattha sīsabhār'ādīsu asammoh'atthaṃ sīs'ādīnaṃ paricchedo veditabbo. tattha sīsassa tāva purimagale galavāṭako, piṭṭhigale kesañci kesante āvaṭṭo hoti, galass'eva ubhosu passesu kesañci kesā oruyha jāyanti, ye kaṇṇacūḷikā'ti vuccanti, tesaṃ adhobhāgo cā'ti ayaṃ heṭṭhimaparicchedo, tato upari sīsaṃ. etth'antare ṭhitabhāro sīsabhāro nāma.

examples.text: iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānarogo jivhārogo kāyarogo sīsarogo kaṇṇarogo mukharogo dantarogo oṭṭharogo kāso sāso pināso ḍāho jaro kucchirogo mucchā

63290.meaning1: purgative for the head; remedy for expelling mucus

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… vamanaṃ virecanaṃ uddhaṃvirecanaṃ adhovirecanaṃ sīsavirecanaṃ kaṇṇatelaṃ nettatappanaṃ natthukammaṃ añjanaṃ paccañjanaṃ sālākiyaṃ sallakattiyaṃ dārakatikicchā mūlabhesajjānaṃ anuppadānaṃ osadhīnaṃ paṭimokkho
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā.

63293.commentary: (MNa) sīsavedanā hontī'ti kutoci nikkhamituṃ alabhamānehi vātehi samuṭṭhāpitā balavatiyo sīsavedanā honti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya, evam'eva kho me, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā honti.

63294.meaning1: who has washed their head; who has bathed their head

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭīyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya

63295.meaning1: keeping the head in sight; following the head
63295.commentary: (VINa) sīs'ānulokikā'ti paṭhamaṃ pavisantīnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ sīsaṃ anulokentī pavisati, anāpatti

63296.meaning1: keeping the head in sight; following the head
63296.commentary: (MNa) sīs'ānulokī'ti yo unnataṭṭhāne piṭṭhiṃ passanto ninnaṭṭhāne sīsaṃ passanto gacchati, ayam'pi sīs'ānulokī'ti vuccati. tādiso hutvā anubandhi.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto taramānarūpo nisīdanaṃ ādāya āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi sīs'ānulokī.
tena kho pana samayena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa sattavassiko sīs'ābādho hoti. bahū mahantā mahantā disāpāmokkhā vejjā āgantvā n'āsakkhiṃsu arogaṃ kātuṃ.

63299.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; Sāriputta's sister
63299.commentary: (THIa) tassā nāmaggahaṇadivase cālā'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu, tassā kaniṭṭhāya upacālā'ti, atha tassā kaniṭṭhāya sīs'ūpacālā'ti. imā tisso'pi dhammasenāpatissa kaniṭṭhabhaginiyo, imāsaṃ puttānam'pi tiṇṇaṃ idam'eva nāmaṃ. ye sandhāya theragāthāya, cāle upacāle sīsūpacāle'ti (theragā. 42) āgataṃ.

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā yena sīsupacālā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā sīsupacālaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca, kassa nu tvaṃ, bhikkhuni, pāsaṇḍaṃ rocesī'ti? na khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, kassaci pāsaṇḍaṃ rocemī'ti.
